Subject: Quick debrief: Aria Nunez — initial screen notes + recommended next steps

Quick notes from today's 30-min screen (summary for the hiring loop):
- Strong hands-on front-end + infra empathy; shipped production dashboard for model metrics at 10k qps.
- Comfortable with PyTorch/torchscript and performance profiling; had concrete suggestions for KV cache handling in the UI layer.
- Communication: clear, concise, good cross-team instincts.

Concerns / flags:
- Limited exposure to our specific infra stack (Ray/Triton) but has quick learning examples. Recommend a take-home exercise focused on telemetry visualization and a follow-up loop with Engineering Manager.

Next steps: Marcus to open GH interview packet and route to Hiring Manager (Dev Patel) + Eng Manager loop. Priya — thanks again for the intro; we'll keep you posted.
